questions.key_step: Right-angle (Thales) circle: z zbar = alpha^2

questions.key_step: Combine group sums, then sigma^2 = mean of squares - mean^2

questions.key_step: Add products over triples of sides; one product for quadrilaterals

questions.key_step: Complement: all n shots miss, (2/3)^n < 1/6

questions.key_step: r^2/r! split to two exponential series

questions.key_step: List sequences ending at second A with at most two B's

questions.key_step: Points are (+-x,+-y): rectangle centred at origin

questions.key_step: Digit multisets 1111123 and 1111222

questions.key_step: Geometric series with ratio P(miss)P(miss)

questions.justification: Parity patterns of places and an ambiguity about the start place.

questions.key_step: Boy-boy plus girl-girl products
questions.justification: Two products added; one-step linear equation.
